name: empty-state
title: EmptyState
description: What a screen shows when it has nothing: an icon, a sentence about why it is empty, and the action that would fill it. Copy: the title says what is missing, not that something is missing — "No invoices yet", never "No results". The description says WHY it is empty and what would fill it; if the reason is a filter, say so, because that is a different screen from a first run.
